views.prompt: Full-body character reference for 3D modelling of a 67-year-old Russian pensioner who sells boiled corn in the street: short and stout, kind round face with wrinkles, rosy cheeks, short grey permed hair, small gold earrings; a warm dark-green quilted vest over a beige knitted cardigan, a flowered cotton apron to the knees, dark brown wool skirt to mid-calf, thick beige tights, comfortable brown low boots. Strict T-pose: standing straight, arms stretched out horizontally to the sides at shoulder height, elbows straight, palms facing down, fingers together, feet shoulder width apart, flat on the floor. Neutral calm expression, mouth closed, eyes open. Whole body visible from the top of the hair to the soles of the shoes, centred, nothing cropped. Orthographic-looking views, camera at chest height. Plain light grey seamless studio background, soft even shadowless lighting, no props, no bag, no text, no headscarf, photorealistic, realistic body proportions.
